reviews.title: Great RAM
reviews.comment: Runs at 6000mhz as is it should and has solid timings with Expo on. I've used this kit on both Ryzen 7000 and 9000 series without a single RAM issue on boot.
reviews.author: Spencer

reviews.title: Stable, fast, way too expensive
reviews.comment: I have the 32gb kit installed on a Gigabyte Aorus Z890, with Core i9 ultra 2 (285k).  Needed to configure BIOS options to enable 6000 MT/s. My system is primarily a Plex Server + OTA Live TV and a couple of HDHomeRun flex 4 devices.  The memory is stable, fast and it is serving its purpose. The price though…I can’t describe  how difficult it was for me to purchase two stick of ddr5 for the same price as a highly capable mini-pc.  Not a good time.  Never spending that much for memory ever again, looks like 32gb is my limit.
reviews.author: Bryan A.
